thing-type.label: Garmin inReach Device
thing-type.description: Garmin inReach satellite communicator tracked via MapShare KML feed. Provides GPS position, speed, elevation, course, and event data via Iridium satellite network.

parameter.name: mapShareId
parameter.label: MapShare Identifier
parameter.description: The MapShare URL identifier (last segment of your MapShare URL, e.g., share.garmin.com/MyTracker)

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: MapShare Password
parameter.description: MapShare access code / password (if feed is password-protected)

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: How often to poll the MapShare feed for new data (seconds). The inReach typically reports every 10 minutes, so polling more often than every 60 seconds provides little benefit.

parameter.name: historyHours
parameter.label: History Window
parameter.description: How many hours of historical data to request from the feed. Larger windows return more data but take longer to parse.

channel-type.label: Last Update
channel-type.description: Timestamp of the most recent tracking point

channel-type.label: Speed
channel-type.description: Current speed reported by the device

channel-type.label: Course
channel-type.description: Direction of travel in degrees (0-360°, true north)

channel-type.label: Event
channel-type.description: Latest event type from the device (e.g., Tracking interval received, Tracking turned on/off, Location received)

channel-type.label: GPS Fix
channel-type.description: Whether the device has a valid GPS fix

channel-type.label: Emergency / SOS
channel-type.description: Whether the device has an active SOS emergency

channel-type.label: Text Message
channel-type.description: Last text message sent from the device

channel-type.label: Tracking Active
channel-type.description: Whether the device is actively sending tracking data (derived from recent point age)

channel-type.label: Distance from Last
channel-type.description: Distance traveled since previous tracking point
